summary.text: Six Arm Heavenly Zombie King is Mo Yao's killer move for Fang Yuan, nearing perfection from his earlier four arm line. It uses borrow strength Gu as the core, six types of flying zombie Gu as supplement, and another thirty-six Gu in a specialized structure.

claims.text: From a thought left by Mo Yao’s will, Fang Yuan obtains the killer move. It grows from four arm earth king and four arm wind king after he finds borrow strength Gu in the treasure room of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.
He later ranks the finished move among the valuable gains from her pointers.

Mo Yao calls six arm heavenly zombie king a strength path killer move with high requirements toward the body. Fang Yuan concludes that, strictly speaking, it is a transformation path killer move that gathers zombie energy to turn a person into a flying zombie, so the body becomes far stronger and can hold even greater strength. Mo Yao agrees that borrow strength Gu borrows the strength of natural phenomena in heaven and earth, and that a zombie body complements that borrow because it surpasses living flesh and regenerates well.

The genuine move keeps borrow strength Gu as core with the six great flying zombie Gu as backbone and many support Gu. Fang Yuan and Mo Yao also issue a downgraded reward version that swaps overlord Gu in as core, keeps older earth chief zombie Gu in place of her modified recipe, and adds intention Gu among support Gu so testers feed them data.

Further polish cuts many supplementary Gu while leaving the core and six zombie Gu unchanged, and adds only a few new supplements. As long as each activation stays within thirty minutes, repeated use does not accumulate zombie energy or grow zombie speckles. Past that limit, zombie energy damages the body; overuse can turn the Gu Master into a real zombie that yin-yang rotation Gu cannot reverse. Mo Yao rates the polished move’s power as doubled with a thirty minute duration she calls enough for the mortal realm, and places that power among the top five killer moves in her memory, while Fang Yuan still seeks a way to remove the backlash itself.

Borrow strength Gu feeds a steady torrent of natural strength from heaven, earth, fire, water, and similar sources. The move temporarily turns the body into a heavenly zombie: half-dead recovery rises, pain falls, and strength feels near endless because living fatigue no longer binds the same way. In a private test, Fang Yuan in this form beats flying bear phantom Immortal Gu at half a flying bear’s battle strength when that Gu fights alone without its accompanying Gu set.
Under pressure from Giant Sun’s will, zombie speckles spread until he completes the transformation rather than remove the move. Once fully transformed he no longer needs Gu worms to hold the form.
Fang Yuan charges that Mo Yao created six arm heavenly zombie king for him and purposely mistimed the limit so the change would stick.
